title: Eating Well and Moving
text:
Maria wants to be healthy. She eats fruit and vegetables every day. She drinks water with her meals.

Maria also moves her body. She walks to school in the morning. On weekends, she rides her bike with her friends.

questions.text: What does Maria eat every day?
How does Maria go to school?
What can you infer about Maria's habits?
options: She is careful about her health

questions.text: Why does Maria ride her bike with friends on weekends?
options: She wants to stay active and have fun
She has no money for food
She is angry at her friends

vocabulary.definition: in good condition for the body
plants or parts of plants that people eat as food
moves on foot at a slow or normal pace

paragraph_translations: Maria quer ser saudável. Ela come frutas e legumes todos os dias. Ela bebe água com as refeições.
Maria também movimenta o corpo. Ela anda até a escola de manhã. Nos fins de semana, ela anda de bicicleta com os amigos.
